notes.text: Changed: Only show message notification configuration actions above the cutoff
Fixed: Account drawer stayed open after account switch despite auto-select Inbox setting
Fixed: Imported settings could incorrectly show 'XX' avatar monogram
Fixed: Printed emails omitted message headers and used minimal margins
Fixed: Compose button did not work in tablet split-screen message view
Fixed: Accented subfolder names sorted to bottom instead of locale order
Fixed: Disabled font size setting appeared in General Settings search
Fixed: New mail notifications showed avatars when contact pictures were disabled
Fixed: Mail opening still used fade-in after animations were disabled
Fixed: Sidebar account-switching animations were too fast
